The report expects the 10-year benchmark bond yield to trade between 7.40% and 7.60% in the near term.

articles.title: DoorDash in talks to buy Instacart in roughly $17 billion deal
articles.desc: DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire Instacart in a deal that could value the grocery-delivery platform at about $17 billion, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday.

articles.desc: The artificial intelligence lab filed papers Monday setting up a Wall Street debut next month, ahead of its chief rival OpenAI and just months after SpaceX set records in June with an initial public offering that raised $86 billion.

articles.title: Why Walmart would rather keep Flipkart private, for now
articles.desc: Over the past few weeks, much has been written about former employees of the online commerce company writing to Walmart's board, asking for liquidity on the stock options they were granted 10 to 15 years ago. On October 1, at least eight former senior executives, among them former Myntra CEO Mukesh Bansal and former chief business officer Ankit Nagori, wrote to Walmart chairman Gregory Penner, other board members and Flipkart Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy, seeking a complete exit for all former employees holding vested options.

articles.title: Govt seeks investor and expert views on LTCG and STT as it reviews capital market levies amid FPI exodus
articles.desc: The government has initiated a reassessment of long-term capital gains tax and securities transaction tax. Stakeholders, including investors and tax experts, have been consulted for their views. The debate has gained momentum due to significant outflows of foreign portfolio investments. Current taxation methods may affect the attractiveness of Indian equities compared to global markets. The upcoming budget provides an opportunity to revisit these tax regulations.

articles.title: Cotton shortage set to worsen as new deals drive export demand
articles.desc: The impact of El Nino weather conditions could further hurt domestic production, expected to fall by 3.4% to a new low in the 2026-27 crop year ended September. Cotton imports hit a record high in 2025-26 to an estimated 7.1 million bales of 170 kilograms compared to last year's imports of 5.74 million bales. Prices have also risen more than 7% in the past month.

articles.title: India and US fine-tune trade pact after concluding most talks, says Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: India and the United States have nearly finalized discussions regarding a proposed bilateral trade agreement. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal mentioned that fine-tuning of the agreement is currently underway. This follows remarks from US Secretary of State Marco Rubio about a few remaining details. Initially, the US removed a penalty on Indian goods related to Russian oil purchases.

articles.title: FTA with India will be a game changer in supply chain management: EU ambassador to India
articles.desc: EU ambassador to India Jean-Eric Paquet further said, "We are creating an economic space across India and the European internal market. That is what is being established, creating a long-term perspective and reliability for economic operators, which will obviously build on very significant trade already."

articles.title: EU can learn from India on cutting regulatory burden, says Piyush Goyal as Dutch minister rules out CBAM rethink
articles.desc: Piyush Goyal addressed the India-Netherlands Business Forum, highlighting India's deregulation efforts to reduce burdens on businesses. He asserted that the EU could learn from India's successful approach to regulatory matters. Dutch Minister Sjoerd Sjoerdsma acknowledged the importance of necessary regulations but emphasized the need to review those that hinder trade. He reiterated that climate and product safety regulations are crucial for European consumers.

articles.desc: The RealReal, a secondhand luxury fashion consignment retailer, said it's updating its bot defense system, effectively making it harder for AI agents to shop on its site. The change comes days after The Verge reported that an AI agent could be used to take advantage of The RealReal's item reserve system. On the retailer's website, […]

articles.title: MoSPI to start annual unincorporated sector enterprises survey from April 2027
articles.desc: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation will conduct the Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises from April 2027. New questions will address gender-specific constraints faced by female entrepreneurs for the first time. Additionally, the survey will capture the investment in fixed assets over an extended period. The survey period has shifted to align with the financial year for better data utility.

articles.title: ISMA says 107 sugar mills begin crushing operations so far, enough stock to meet domestic demand
articles.desc: Nearly 110 sugar mills have begun operations for the 2026-27 sugar marketing year in several states. The Indian Sugar & Bio-Energy Manufacturers Association stated that the industry is prepared for sugarcane crushing. This readiness helps meet the expected domestic sugar demand of 280-285 lakh tonne annually. The government has also extended duty-free import windows to maintain sugar availability during the festive period.

articles.title: MoSPI report shows Rs 3.22 lakh crore cost overrun in India’s ongoing infrastructure projects
articles.desc: Infrastructure projects worth over Rs 150 crore have seen a cumulative cost overrun of approximately Rs 3,21,976 crore. About 1,853 infrastructure projects across 17 ministries were monitored, showing total costs revised to Rs 37,55,803 crore. The Ministry of Road Transport & Highways leads with the most ongoing projects and costs. Approximately 47.21 percent of the total project cost has been spent so far, indicating steady progress.

articles.title: CBDT receives around 1,100 applications under foreign assets disclosure scheme
articles.desc: Since the launch of the Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme, approximately 1,100 taxpayers have submitted applications. The scheme provides an opportunity to disclose unreported foreign assets and income at a 60 percent tax rate. Taxpayers can access information about their assets reported by foreign jurisdictions through the e-filing portal. Outreach programs have been initiated to raise awareness among various groups regarding this scheme.

articles.title: India’s outward FDI falls 14% to $4.34 billion in September as loans, guarantees decline
articles.desc: Outward foreign direct investment from India reached $4.34 billion in September, which is a 14% increase from last year. However, this figure reflects a 37% decrease from the previous month. Equity commitments decreased by 20% compared to August, totaling $3.26 billion. Loans to overseas subsidiaries rose slightly, reaching $549 million in September. Several companies, including Sun Pharma, led the equity outflows with significant investments.
